speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of tics and current use of haloperidol, I need to assess for extrapyramidal symptoms or Neuroleptic Malignant Syndrome. Do you have any muscle rigidity, excessive sweating, or tremors, and have you recently increased your medication dose?
